findings: Independent replay confirms a real published CWE-639 IDOR: any authenticated non-admin reaches URL-selected avatar mutation sinks because the owner comparison cannot match a Django string capture and login_required permits the already-authenticated request.
The smallest public vulnerable writer is 929cba67ae17fc5183001adf4f732e30c0b635da; its immediate parent lacks both the user-selected mutation surface and broken authorization check.
The affected 0.12.2 lineage contains the BIC without the fix, while the 0.12.3 package lineage contains direct fix 3da3d75f35204aa71633c7a315327ba39cb6295d.
BIC-only provenance supports NOT_AI; no correction to the primary record is required.
